# REBEL: Repeated Measures Empirical Bayes Differential Expression Analysis Using Linear Mixed Models

**REBEL** is an R package for cell-type specific differential expression
analysis in repeated measures single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq)
studies.

The package applies linear mixed models and empirical Bayes moderation
to identify differentially expressed genes while accounting for
within-subject correlation arising from paired, longitudinal, and other
repeated measures study designs.

**Website:** [REBEL website](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/)

**Vignette:** - [Introduction to
REBEL](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/articles/rebelVignette.html)

## Getting Started

### Install Dependencies

``` r

## CRAN packages
install.packages(
  c(
    "dplyr",
    "lme4",
    "lmerTest",
    "limma",
    "Matrix",
    "pbapply",
    "pbkrtest"
  )
)

## Bioconductor packages
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install(
  c(
    "DESeq2",
    "SingleCellExperiment",
    "SummarizedExperiment"
  )
)
```

### Install REBEL from GitHub

**Note:** The package vignettes are available on the package website. If
you’d prefer to build the vignettes locally during installation, you can
set `build_vignettes = TRUE`, though this may take longer.

`{r} if (!requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) { install.packages("devtools") } devtools::install_github("https://github.com/ewynn610/REBEL", build_vignettes = FALSE)`

# Package index

## All functions

- [`RebelFit-class`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/RebelFit-class.md)
  : The RebelFit class
- [`RecAM_sim_pb`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/RecAM_sim_pb.md)
  : Example Simulated Repeated Measures Pseudo-bulk scRNA-Seq Data
- [`RecAM_sim_sce`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/RecAM_sim_sce.md)
  : Example Simulated Repeated Measures scRNA-Seq Data
- [`getEBEstimates()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/getEBEstimates.md)
  : Extract Empirical Bayes Estimates from RebelFitObj
- [`getEBParameters()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/getEBParameters.md)
  : Extract Empirical Bayes Parameters from RebelFitObj
- [`getGeneNames()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/getGeneNames.md)
  : Extract Gene Names from RebelFitObj
- [`getModelMatrix()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/getModelMatrix.md)
  : Extract Model Matrix from RebelFitObj
- [`getOriginalFitVar()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/getOriginalFitVar.md)
  : Extract Original Variance Estimates from RebelFitObj
- [`rebelAggregate()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/rebelAggregate.md)
  : Aggregate data for pseudo-bulk analysis
- [`rebelEmpBayes()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/rebelEmpBayes.md)
  : Run Empirical Bayes procedure on linear mixed models
- [`rebelFit()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/rebelFit.md)
  : Fit REBEL Models
- [`rebelKRParams()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/rebelKRParams.md)
  : Estimate parameters for Kenward Rogers Degrees of freedom
- [`rebelLMM()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/rebelLMM.md)
  : Fit linear mixed models on cell level of pseudo-bulk data
- [`rebelTest()`](https://ewynn610.github.io/REBEL/reference/rebelTest.md)
  : Run hypothesis testing using models fit using REBEL
